title: Revenge on Protector Wu
summary: With the third change of the Sky Fire Three Mysterious Changes, Xiao Yan forces his power up to Seven-Star Dou Zong. He breaks Protector Wu's Hundred Souls Locking Sky Python and beats him with the Flame Splitting Tsunami, the Six Joint Fire, the Open Mountain Seal and the Sea Flipping Seal. Protector Wu calls for Hall of Souls help, and Tian She attacks Xiao Yan with Bing Xuan and Bing Hua. Xiao Yan sets the Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique against their Ice River Array and Ice God Bow, and brings down all three before his technique runs out. He holds Protector Wu and tells him his pain is nothing next to Yao Lao's. Qing Hai Zun Zhe of the Hall of Souls, a Two-Star Dou Zun, arrives and orders Xiao Yan taken. As Qing Hai Zun Zhe moves on Xiao Yan, the Little Fairy Doctor warns him that if he hurts Xiao Yan he will die.
events: The third change lifts Xiao Yan to Seven-Star Dou Zong.
Xiao Yan defeats Protector Wu with a chain of Advanced Dou Skills.
Protector Wu sends a signal to the Hall of Souls.
Tian She, Bing Xuan and Bing Hua attack Xiao Yan.
The Five Ring Flame Expelling Technique beats the Ice River Array and the Ice God Bow.
Qing Hai Zun Zhe arrives and goes after Xiao Yan.
The Little Fairy Doctor steps in.
cultivation: The third change raises Xiao Yan from Two-Star to Seven-Star Dou Zong for a limited time. Protector Wu is an Eight-Star Dou Zong. Qing Hai Zun Zhe is a Two-Star Dou Zun.
